scripts.typecheck:static: tsc --noEmit --incremental false --strict --jsx react-jsx --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --lib dom,dom.iterable,esnext --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule --allowImportingTsExtensions app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/robots.ts app/sitemap.ts app/components/LegalPage.tsx app/components/SiteFrame.tsx app/account-deletion/page.tsx app/about/page.tsx app/contact/page.tsx app/download/page.tsx app/privacy/page.tsx app/privacy/data-list/page.tsx app/services/page.tsx app/subscription/page.tsx app/support/page.tsx app/terms/page.tsx app/wechat/page.tsx app/services/checkout/page.tsx app/services/orders/page.tsx app/services/payment-return/page.tsx app/services/purchase-info/page.tsx app/services/sign-in/page.tsx
scripts.build:static: npm run typecheck:static && npm run typecheck:purchase && PLANCHIME_STATIC_EXPORT=1 next build
scripts.typecheck:purchase: tsc --noEmit --incremental false --strict --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --lib dom,dom.iterable,esnext --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions app/lib/purchase/commerce.ts app/lib/purchase/recovery.ts
scripts.test:purchase: npm run typecheck:purchase && node --test tests/web-purchase-client.test.mjs tests/web-wechat-purchase-client.test.mjs tests/web-purchase-prelaunch.test.mjs
